messages:
sanjay: quick heads-up — EU Dedicated pool needs 120 GPUs to cover Q3 onboarding. Prefer EU stock to avoid cross-border tax. Target latest ship date 2025-06-10. Also we have ~60 units at AMS flagged for RMA (thermal failures). Can vendor fold replacements into the same outbound shipment to save unit freight and broker touches?

kai_vendor: hey @sanjay 120 units from EU inventory: lead time 6 weeks if we allocate from our NL pool; otherwise factory ship 102 weeks. Pricing: bulk 120 => $37,800/unit; smaller 60 => $38,900/unit. We can mix local stock + factory top-up.

emma_ops: question on billing: do you require deposit? we prefer Net45 for smaller buys, Net30 for >$750k. Also need SKU batch traceability (lots changed firmware v2.1 recently).

kai_vendor: deposit 20% on factory orders; for pool pulls we can invoice Net30 for enterprise. We'll include firmware build and checksum in packing list for each serial.

rafa: RMA note 5 units at AMS are DOA vs 15 are thermal intermittent. Depot wants consolidated AWB to reduce handling. Are we doing replacements air or sea? sea saves cost but delays onboarding.

sanjay: replacements for DOA must be air. Thermal intermittent we can accept refurbished swaps if vendor certifies L3 refurb + burn-in. Tradeoff: refurbished replacements ship in 7 business days from manifest, new units 141 days.

kai_vendor: we can offer mixed flow: air ship 30 DOA immediate; remaining 30 thermal swapped via consolidated sea pallet (ETA ~21 days). Consolidated manifest must include serial + failure code. Broker fee share: vendor covers up to $275/awb for warranty RMAs.

emma_ops: can vendor pre-stage 30 new units in NL so we can image them and run KV-cache warmup before rolling into production? also need staging SLA: 48h power-on, burn-in 12h, image pre-load. Any fee?

kai_vendor: pre-stage available. Fee $120/unit or complimentary if you commit 100+ units. Imaging upload endpoint & allowed base images: please send container registry/AMI list.

rma_coordinator: we'll prepare manifest CSV. sample header pls and preferred file encoding. depot requires UTF-8 and .csv only. Also remind: depot will not release until 3-party sign-off (vendor, redwood, depot).

kai_vendor: sample CSV header:
```
serial,sku,fail_code,depot_code,date_reported,customer_contact,preauth_id
```
UTF-8 CSV ok. We'll send RMA manifest template and prefilled AWB instructions.

emma_ops: typo in previous line? (small correction)

logistics_bot: LogisticsTracker: tentative PO 900112 acknowledged. tentative ship window: 2025-06-05 to 2025-06-12. tracker: https://logistics.vendor.example/900112

sanjay: insurance sanity check 50k default carrier liability? need vendor to state coverage split in writing: transit damage (carrier) vs vendor warranty (DOA). Also customs HS code for GPUs in NL? will we face VAT deferment?

kai_vendor: transit liability per carrier GRI; vendor warranty covers DOA & manufacturing defects. We'll include optional cargo insurance quote in offer. HS code we typically declare as 8471.60.00 for computing modules in NL paperwork; final classification depends on importer-of-record. We can provide ATA carnet or temporary import docs for staging to avoid VAT where possible, but need importer details and EORI.

emma_ops: EORI is REDWOOD-EU-0001. we'll send importer details once quote looks right. please include customs brokerage fees estimate in offer.

rafa: one more constraint: our Dedicated pool animate scaling requires <2ms added p99 network overhead. If staging changes firmware or bios, annotate in manifest so we can gate canary.

kai_vendor: understood. firmware notes included per serial. will attach checksums and bios versions.

sanjay: final asks before PO: 1) written quote with 120-unit price + deposit terms 2) confirmation vendor will cover broker fee up to $275/awb for RMAs 3) RMA CSV template and manifest turnaround SLA (we need signed manifest by 2025-05-15 to hit replacement ETA)

kai_vendor: sending formal quote and manifest template by EOD CET. summary: 120 units from NL pool $37,800/unit, no staging fee if commit >=100, broker fee cap $275/awb for warranty replacements, air for DOA within 7 business days after manifest sign, sea pallet for swaps ~21 days. Will cc rma@vendor.example with templates. :white_check_mark:

emma_ops: thanks. we'll review and aim to sign manifest by 2025-05-12.

logistics_bot: LogisticsTracker: quote doc 900112-v1 uploaded to vendor portal. link: https://logistics.vendor.example/docs/900112-v1

sanjay: great work 1 see quote then proceed.
